definitionZh: 覆盖 CSS 属性指定在顶层出现的元素(例如显示的弹出式或模式对话框元素)是否在顶层实际渲染. 此属性仅在过渡-财产值列表中相关,并且只有在允许-差异被设定为过渡-行为时才相关.
sourceDefinition: The overlay CSS property specifies whether an element appearing in the top layer (for example, a shown popover or modal dialog element) is actually rendered in the top layer. This property is only relevant within a list of transition-property values, and only if allow-discrete is set as the transition-behavior.
